intended_object: The group-valued functor of points of the roots-of-unity group scheme μ_n = Spec K[ℤ/n] over Spec K, restricted to affine test schemes. It sends a commutative K-algebra A to the group Hom_{Spec K}(Spec A, μ_n). Inferred from the docstring and from its use in rootsOfUnityPointsIso.
explanation: The body composes Mathlib's algSpec (A ↦ Spec A over Spec K, contravariant, made covariant by rightOp) with yonedaGrp.obj of the group object rootsOfUnityGroupScheme K n. yonedaGrp.obj sends T to Hom(T, G), with the group law induced by G. So the composite is A ↦ Hom_{Spec K}(Spec A, μ_n) with its natural group structure, and K-algebra maps act by precomposition. This is the functor of points of μ_n on affine test schemes. The library uses it as the target of the natural isomorphism with A ↦ μ_n(A). It is stated over an arbitrary commutative ring K and any natural number n, which is the natural setting. It is a specific object that reuses Mathlib's general constructions rather than duplicating them.
